body:
Dear Friend,
We need your products urgently. Payment will be made by USDT or Bitcoin only.
Please send invoice immediately and use a private account for faster settlement.
Waiting for your urgent reply.
reply:
Dear [Recipient],

Thank you for your message. However, I must express my concerns regarding the proposed payment method and the urgency indicated in your request. For the sake of compliance and security, we only accept more conventional payment options through verified channels.

Additionally, could you please confirm your company name and location? This will help us ensure a safe and smooth transaction process.

I look forward to your prompt reply.

Xian Diao
DIOX Ltd.
admin@example.com
+44 1234567890
